adaptations: hand-written case (happy + edge) — no upstream libxslt coverage exists for math:constant. Pins significant-digit rounding of every recognized name (including the EXSLT-spec spelling SQRRT2), the precision < 1 passthrough (full double value), and NaN for unknown names. Values are the XPath 3.1 double literals of the Bosak engine (engine-verified), matching libxslt's double literals bit-for-bit at full precision. Goldens are engine-verified output of src/math.xsl.
